name: }IDE.Backup
description: Archive the server's data folder into the sibling 'backup' folder, before a deploy replaces the model. SaveDataAll first, then one numbered archive via Windows tar.exe, verified by its presence. No Bedrock, no generated script.

parameters.Name: pTargetDir
parameters.Prompt: Folder for the archive. Default '..\backup' — beside the data folder, never inside it.

parameters.Name: pFormat
parameters.Prompt: zip (one archive) or copy (a folder copy, for a server without a zip tool).

parameters.Name: pKeep
parameters.Prompt: How many archives to keep in the folder. Older ones are deleted by this process.
